meta.title: Solutions — the websites and systems we build
meta.description: Corporate and multilingual websites, online stores, online learning platforms, customer portals, internal systems and AI assistants.

title: Solutions
lead: The kinds of websites and systems we design and build. Each solution is shaped around the specific business.

items.title: Corporate and multilingual websites
items.text: Fast websites with strong search visibility that your team can update without a developer.

items.title: Online stores
items.text: Catalogue, basket, payment and delivery, connected to your stock and accounting.

items.title: Online learning platforms
items.text: Courses, lessons, progress tracking, enrolment and payment, certificates and an admin panel.

items.title: Customer portals
items.text: A secure place where your customers submit requests, follow their status, pay and find their documents.

items.title: Internal systems and integrations
items.text: Admin panels, reports and connections between systems that replace spreadsheets and manual copying of data.

items.title: AI assistants
items.text: Assistants that answer from your documents and data and handle repetitive enquiries.

note: We publish information about specific projects only with our clients' consent.

technology.title: Technology
technology.lead: We choose the technology to fit the task, not the other way round. We work with established tools that are maintained for the long term and easy to hire for.

groups.title: Front end
groups.reason: Pages are sent ready from the server, so the website loads fast and is found by search engines. TypeScript catches errors before they reach the visitor.

groups.title: Back end
groups.reason: Node.js for custom-built applications. WordPress when your team needs to update the content themselves, without a developer.

groups.title: Data
groups.reason: Established open-source databases: no licence fees and no dependence on a single vendor. Your data stays portable.

groups.title: Infrastructure
groups.reason: The system runs the same on our machines and on the server. Updates are released automatically and can be rolled back.
